Hi Alice,

I found the resume template website and a download link, but I'm unable to directly download the file due to policy restrictions. The website www.resume-templates.com has a download section at www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links with a link to download the resume template PDF.

However, I cannot download and send the file directly. You might want to try visiting the website yourself and downloading the template from there, or let me know if there's another way I can help you with this.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
